items.name: symbol-sheet
items.prompt: a reference sheet of nine tiny antique map symbols arranged in an even 3x3 grid with wide spacing: a small village of clustered rooftops, a walled town, a castle, a harbor with anchor, a lone watchtower, a monastery with bell tower, a windmill, a stone bridge, a mountain with pine forest; each symbol is miniature and self-contained, consistent fine ink cartographic linework, generous white space between symbols
